function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m here to help you with a wide range of tasks—everything from answering questions and providing explanations to assisting with planning, troubleshooting, and even controlling smart devices. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do: | Category | What I can help with | |----------|----------------------| | **Information & Learning** | • Explain concepts (science, math, history, tech, etc.)
• Summarize articles or documents
• Provide definitions, synonyms, and translations | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, reports, essays, or creative pieces
• Proofread and suggest edits for clarity, tone, and grammar
• Generate outlines or bullet points | | **Planning & Organization** | • Create schedules, itineraries, or project plans
• Offer reminders and checklists
• Help prioritize tasks | | **Problem Solving** | • Assist with troubleshooting tech issues
• Offer step‑by‑step guides for DIY projects
• Provide troubleshooting tips for common household problems | | **Smart Device Control** | • Adjust settings on compatible smart devices (e.g., thermostats, lights, locks)
• Read current device status and diagnostics
• Automate routines or set conditions | | **Entertainment & Creativity** | • Generate jokes, riddles, or trivia
• Suggest books, movies, or music based on preferences
• Create stories, poems, or dialogues | | **Health & Wellness** | • Offer general wellness tips (exercise, nutrition, sleep hygiene)
• Explain medical terms and conditions (but not a substitute for professional advice) | | **Finance & Budgeting** | • Explain financial concepts (interest rates, budgeting, investing basics)
• Help draft budgets or expense trackers | | **Travel & Navigation** | • Provide travel recommendations, packing lists, or itinerary ideas
• Offer real‑time traffic updates and route suggestions | | **Language & Culture** | • Translate short phrases or sentences
• Explain cultural customs or etiquette | --- ### Smart Device Control (Air Conditioner Example) If you have a smart air conditioner connected to your system, I can directly interact with it using two built‑in functions: 1. **`get_ac_state`** – Retrieve the current status of the AC (mode, temperature, power, diagnostics). 2. **`set_ac_state`** – Change the AC’s settings (temperature, mode, fan speed, fan position). #### How It Works - **Getting Status** ```json { "unit_id": "living_room_ac", "include_diagnostics": true } ``` This call returns the current mode, temperature, power status, and optional diagnostics. - **Setting State** ```json { "temperature": 22, "mode": "cool", "fan_speed": 3, "fan_position": 2 } ``` This call adjusts the AC to the specified settings. You can ask me to read the current state, adjust the temperature, change the mode, or set fan speeds—all without leaving this chat. --- ### How to Use - **Ask Directly** – “Set the living room AC to 21 °C in cool mode, fan speed 4.” - **Request Status** – “What’s the current temperature and mode of the bedroom AC?” - **Combine Tasks** – “Turn off the kitchen AC, then set the living room AC to 24 °C in heat mode.” Feel free to let me know what you’d like to do next!
